fields.name: intro
fields.meaning: Description (intro), optionally shown above the page content (pseudofield "printintro" controls whether it is shown).

fields.name: content
fields.meaning: The actual page content (HTML). Set through the "page" pseudofield, not directly - therefore NOT listed here as required even though the column needs a value: the "page" pseudofield fulfills that requirement (#404). Requiring both created a dead end - specifying "content" required "page", specifying "page" required "content".

value_range.source: mod/page/db/install.xml (page.content); set from the "page" pseudofield in mod/page/lib.php (page_update_instance())

fields.name: contentformat
fields.meaning: Text format of the page content. Set through the "page" pseudofield, like "content".

fields.name: display
fields.meaning: Page display (e.g. new window, popup). Available options are a subset configured by Moodle administration, not a fixed list.

value_range.source: lib/resourcelib.php:30-42 (RESOURCELIB_DISPLAY_*-constants), :111 (resourcelib_get_displayoptions()); Subset from admin_setting_configmultiselect('page/displayoptions', ...) in mod/page/settings.php:31-35; column mod/page/db/install.xml (page.display)

pseudofields.name: page
pseudofields.type: array{text: string, format: int, itemid: int}
pseudofields.meaning: Editor array for page content. WITHOUT this field, Moodle silently sets "content" (and "contentformat") to null on update - page_update_instance() reads $data->page['text'] without a guard.

pseudofields.name: printintro
pseudofields.meaning: Show intro alongside page content. Not a DB field - stored in the serialized "displayoptions" column.

pseudofields.name: printlastmodified
pseudofields.meaning: Show modification date below page content. Not a DB field - stored in "displayoptions".

pseudofields.name: popupwidth
pseudofields.meaning: Window width in pixels, only effective for display=6 (popup). Not a DB field - stored in "displayoptions".

value_range.source: mod/page/lib.php (page_update_instance(): only set when display==RESOURCELIB_DISPLAY_POPUP); Default mod/page/settings.php:45

pseudofields.name: popupheight
pseudofields.meaning: Window height in pixels, only effective for display=6 (popup). Not a DB field - stored in "displayoptions".
